name: segment_id
description: Machine and segment number, e.g. TBM9-00123

name: seg_no
description: Number of the segment within the machine series; the value of seg_no in labels/<machine>.parquet

name: stream
description: Data stream of the first row

name: start
description: Time of the first row

name: end
description: Time of the last row

name: duration_s
description: end minus start

name: dt_median_s
description: Median interval between the readings inside the segment

name: ref_source
description: Where the boring flag of the rows comes from, the most common source in the segment: state_boring, state_thrust or signal

name: left_edge
description: What bounds the segment before it: state_change (the flag turned on, previous reading within max_gap_s), pause (a stretch of at least interrupt_s with the flag on and the thrust off was cut away), hole_boring (a reading gap above max_gap_s next to a boring row), hole_other (a gap next to a row that is not boring: the true start may lie in the gap), series_edge (first row of the machine series)

name: right_edge
description: The same after the segment: state_change, pause, hole_boring, hole_other or series_edge (last row of the series)

name: left_censored
description: The left edge is neither a state_change nor a pause: the true start is not observed

name: right_censored
description: The right edge is neither a state_change nor a pause: the true end is not observed

name: gap_before_s
description: Length of the gap before the first row, for hole edges

name: gap_after_s
description: Length of the gap after the last row, for hole edges

name: seg_class
description: blip (shorter than blip_s or without an active row), short (shorter than long_s), long

name: active_rows
description: Rows with F, T, n and v all above zero

name: active_share
description: active_rows / rows

name: valid_share
description: Share of the rows with valid_core

name: lead_inactive_s
description: Time from the first row to the first active row

name: trail_inactive_s
description: Time from the last active row to the last row

name: max_inactive_s
description: Longest spell of rows that are not active between the first and the last active row

name: v_all_med
description: Median advance speed over all rows, zeros included, invalid rows left out

name: stalled
description: v_all_med below stall_v: flag on and thrust on but almost no advance

name: F_med
description: Median over the active rows

name: T_med
description: Median over the active rows

name: n_med
description: Median over the active rows

name: v_med
description: Median over the active rows

name: adv_v_m
description: Integral of the valid advance speed over the segment (reading intervals capped at max_gap_s)

name: counter
description: Position counter used for adv_counter_m: chainage, cutter_mileage or ring

name: adv_counter_m
description: Absolute difference between the last and the first valid counter reading in the segment (counter steps are 0.1 to 1 m)

name: phase_status
description: ok (steady phase found), not_long, few_rows (long but fewer than phase_min_rows readings), few_valid (valid_share below valid_min), no_steady (no positive steady level or no run of readings at the level)

name: steady_start
description: Time of the first steady reading

name: steady_end
description: Time of the last steady reading

name: ramp_s
description: steady_start minus start; empty where the left edge hides the start (hole_boring, series_edge) or there is no steady phase

name: steady_s
description: steady_end minus steady_start

name: end_s
description: end minus steady_end; empty where the right edge is hidden or the stretch is longer than end_max_s

name: tail_s
description: end minus steady_end whether or not it is named an end phase

name: steady_ok_share
description: Share of the steady readings in which the smoothed thrust and advance speed reach their share of the segment level

name: F_level
description: Steady level of the thrust: median over the middle half of the segment

name: T_level
description: Steady level of the torque

name: v_level
description: Steady level of the advance speed

name: F_steady
description: Median thrust over the steady rows

name: T_steady
description: Median torque over the steady rows

name: n_steady
description: Median cutterhead speed over the steady rows

name: v_steady
description: Median advance speed over the steady rows
